correctness.rationale: PASS. For atomic measure mass 1+u, write moments m_k=Σw_j exp(-ikθ_j). The Herglotz exponential is e^(-(1+u)) exp(-2Σm_k z^k), with first variations δm_k=e^(-πik/n)(W_k - i(k/n)E_k) for k<n. Direct expansion of m_n through second order, the z^n exponential recurrence (including products δm_k δm_{n-k}), and modulus expansion cancel the linear u term and isolate u² plus the claimed real Fourier quadratic. Reality pairs W_{n-k}=conj W_k and E analogously; the even-n Nyquist mode is real. Block matrix [[2,i(1-2t)],[-i(1-2t),1-2t(1-t)]] has det=1 and trace=3-2t(1-t), hence lambda_min(t)>(3-sqrt5)/2 for 0<t<1. Unnormalized Fourier Parseval gives n||η||²+n||ε-mean ε||², with common angle shift neutral. Fixed-n Taylor remainder O_n(δ³) is absorbed in some n-dependent neighborhood; first Fourier frequencies k=1,n-1 show optimality only across all degrees, not equality at fixed n. Independent high precision exponential-recurrence finite differences for n=2,3,5,9 gave relative errors 2.5e-8 to 7.6e-8 from the predicted second variation. Symbolic determinant trace and eigenvalue limit prove the all-degree claim, not the finite numeric checks.

value.rationale: PASS. The exact all-degree Hessian is a natural quantitative refinement at the standard extremal candidate, separating mass, weight, angular and rotational directions and supplying a sharp spectral conditioning constant. This can guide local numerical certification and perturbative proofs without claiming a breakthrough on the global Krzyż conjecture. This is not merely a tiny numerical gain: the spectrum and optimal uniform-in-degree gap are structural analytic facts for an established conjectural extremizer.
